title: Serpentine Tier Sweep
source: 103. Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
brief: A warehouse robot picks items from storage organised as a tree of bins, where each bin branches to at most two bins on the tier below. To save travel, it sweeps each tier in the opposite direction from the previous one: it covers the top tier left to right, then turns around for the tier below, and keeps alternating.

Implement serpentineSweep(root), where root is the TreeNode for the top bin and each node's value is a bin label, and return one list of labels per tier, from the top tier down, each in the order the robot visits it.
